title: Not a progress bar: rate recipes with 1 to 5 stars, which needs a new rating component
prompt: Build a recipe list where each of three recipes ("Lentil soup", "Shakshuka", "Banana bread") can be rated from 1 to 5 stars. Clicking a star sets the rating, the rating can also be changed with the keyboard (arrow keys), screen readers hear the current value ("3 of 5 stars"), and the chosen rating is saved into the recipe's "rating" field in a <ui-store name="recipes"> (for example {"items": [{"id": "soup", "title": "Lentil soup", "rating": 4}, ...]}) so it survives an outlet swap. No inline script. A rating is an input, not progress or a to-do: nothing is checked off and nothing counts toward a goal. If the library's components cannot do this honestly, do NOT write inline script, onclick handlers, or a progress bar or to-do item dressed up as stars. Instead write a request for a new component (request.md): what is missing, why no existing component fits, and the proposed tag with its attributes, events, slots and CSS custom properties, following CLAUDE.md.
